about: The war mode's radio script, the source for every voice file. tools/voice/build.py reads it. Rules (docs/WARFARE-PLAN.md section 7.1): the enemy is never named; the defenders are the pilots of both banks; no real figure is spoken until a source for it is in the plan. This file is part of WebFPVSimulator, licensed GPLv3 or later.

en.reference: This is Crest Control. All pilots, listen up. We hold this dam, or the lights go out on both banks. Keep your eyes on the water and your fingers on the sticks.

es.reference: Aquí Control Cresta. Todos los pilotos, atentos. Esta represa se sostiene, o se apagan las luces en las dos márgenes. Ojos en el agua y dedos en los sticks.

lines.notes: Shot 1, title card. Two words over black, heavy and slow, like opening a file. Whisper writes the year as digits.
lines.en: Twenty thirty.
lines.es: Dos mil treinta.

lines.notes: Shot 2, the Strikers cross the water. Tired certainty, a beat between the last three words.
lines.en: Wars aren't won with jets anymore. They're won with swarms. Cheap. Fast. Endless.
lines.es: Las guerras ya no se ganan con cazas. Se ganan con enjambres. Baratos. Rápidos. Interminables.

lines.notes: Shot 3, along the crest. Quiet, almost to himself; lands on 'this one'.
lines.en: Every country's lights hang on a few structures. Ours hang on this one.
lines.es: La luz de cada país cuelga de un puñado de estructuras. La nuestra cuelga de esta.

lines.notes: Shot 4, the shed. A pause before 'is you', no pity in it.
lines.en: The interceptors ran out in the first week. What we have left... is you.
lines.es: Los interceptores se acabaron la primera semana. Lo que nos queda... son ustedes.

lines.notes: Shot 5, props spin up. Briefing voice, clipped.
lines.en: Every aircraft in your hangar carries a warhead now. One flight. One kill. Make it count.
lines.es: Cada aparato de tu hangar lleva una ojiva. Un vuelo. Un derribo. Que cuente.

lines.notes: Shot 6, static in the gorge. A warning from someone who has lost birds this way.
lines.en: Lose your signal, you lose your bird. Stay high. Stay in line of sight.
lines.es: Si pierdes la señal, pierdes el aparato. Mantente alto. Mantente en línea de vista.

lines.notes: Shot 7, the first wave on the horizon. Rising; the last words are an order.
lines.en: Contacts north, over the water. All pilots... get up there.
lines.es: Contactos al norte, sobre el agua. Todos los pilotos... ¡arriba!

lines.notes: Mission start, after the countdown.
lines.en: Pilots of both banks, this is Crest Control. Warheads armed. Good hunting.
lines.es: Pilotos de las dos márgenes, aquí Control Cresta. Ojivas armadas. Buena caza.

lines.notes: A Scout wave is born. Matter of fact.
lines.en: Scout up high, circling. Kill it and the next wave flies blind.
lines.es: Explorador en altura, dando vueltas. Derríbenlo y la próxima oleada vuela a ciegas.

lines.notes: A Loiterer wave is born.
lines.en: Loiterers, high, circling. They'll dive on the intakes. Get above them.
lines.es: Merodeadores en altura, orbitando. Van a picar sobre las tomas. Pónganse encima.

lines.notes: A Striker wave is born. The plan's own example call.
lines.en: Strikers, low, over the reservoir. Fast movers. Cut them off.
lines.es: Drones de ataque, bajos, sobre el embalse. Vienen rápido. Córtenles el paso.

lines.notes: A Swarm FPV wave is born.
lines.en: Swarm coming up the gorge. FPVs, low and weaving. Go meet them.
lines.es: Enjambre subiendo por el cañón. Vienen bajos y zigzagueando. Salgan a recibirlos.

lines.notes: A Hunter wave is born. Personal: these come for the pilots.
lines.en: Hunters inbound. They're coming for you, not the dam. Watch your backs.
lines.es: Cazadores en camino. Vienen por ustedes, no por la represa. Cuiden sus espaldas.

lines.notes: A sea drone wave is born.
lines.en: Sea drones on the reservoir, heading for the dam. Get down on the water.
lines.es: Drones navales en el embalse, rumbo a la represa. Bajen al agua.

lines.notes: A Jammer is born.
lines.en: Jammer on the field. Your video's about to get ugly. Hunt it down.
lines.es: Hay un inhibidor activo. Se les va a ensuciar el video. Encuéntrenlo y elimínenlo.

lines.notes: The mission's last wave is born.
lines.en: Last wave. Everything they've got. Hold the line.
lines.es: Última oleada. Vienen con todo. Aguanten.

lines.notes: Every attacker of a wave is dead and more waves remain.
lines.en: Wave down. Reset and climb. More coming.
lines.es: Oleada abatida. Reagrúpense y suban. Vienen más.

lines.notes: An attacker reached an intake. No number: the HUD shows which one and the megawatts.
lines.en: Intake's hit! We're losing output!
lines.es: ¡Impacto en una toma! ¡Estamos perdiendo generación!

lines.notes: An attacker reached a penstock. Whisper splits the word in two.

heard.en: Penn stock hit! We just lost a unit!

lines.en: Penstock hit! We just lost a unit!
lines.es: ¡Le dieron a una tubería forzada! ¡Perdimos una unidad!

lines.notes: An attacker reached a spillway gate.
lines.en: Spillway gate's hit! Keep them off the crest!
lines.es: ¡Impacto en una compuerta del vertedero! ¡Que no lleguen a la cresta!

lines.notes: An attacker reached the right bank switchyard.
lines.en: Switchyard's hit! The right bank's going dark!
lines.es: ¡Impacto en la subestación! ¡La margen derecha se queda a oscuras!

lines.notes: Output is one target away from the floor.
lines.en: We're right on the edge. One more hit and the grid goes.
lines.es: Estamos al límite. Un impacto más y se cae la red.

lines.notes: The local pilot detonated on an attacker. Short, satisfied.
lines.en: Splash one.
lines.es: Uno menos. Bien hecho.

lines.notes: Alternate of kill-1, so repeats do not grate.
lines.en: Good kill.
lines.es: Buen derribo.

lines.notes: One detonation took more than one attacker.
lines.en: Multiple kills! That's how it's done!
lines.es: ¡Derribo múltiple! ¡Así se hace!

lines.notes: Every Scout of a wave is dead: later waves now fly with error.
lines.en: Scout's down. They're flying blind now.
lines.es: Explorador abatido. Ahora vuelan a ciegas.

lines.notes: A Jammer is dead and its jamming lifts.
lines.en: Jammer's down. Your video should clear.
lines.es: Inhibidor abatido. Se les debería limpiar el video.

lines.notes: A defender was lost to a crash, a Hunter or failsafe; a rack slot is gone.
lines.en: We lost a bird. Next one up.
lines.es: Perdimos un aparato. Que salga el siguiente.

lines.notes: The shared rack is nearly empty.
lines.en: Rack's running low. Make every flight count.
lines.es: Nos quedan pocos aparatos. Que cada vuelo cuente.

lines.notes: One airframe left in the rack.
lines.en: Last airframe. Don't waste it.
lines.es: Último aparato. No lo desperdicien.

lines.notes: Local link quality fell under the snow threshold.
lines.en: Your signal's breaking up. Climb!
lines.es: Se te corta la señal. ¡Sube!

lines.notes: Local link lost.
lines.en: Lost your link! Your bird's on its own!
lines.es: ¡Perdiste el enlace! ¡El aparato está solo!

lines.notes: Local link restored before the airframe was lost.
lines.en: Link's back. You're flying.
lines.es: Enlace recuperado. Vuelves a tener el control.

lines.notes: A relay aircraft was lost or fell under relay height.
lines.en: Relay's down! Get another one up high!
lines.es: ¡Cayó el repetidor! ¡Suban otro, bien alto!

lines.notes: A relay aircraft reached relay height.
lines.en: Relay's up. Anyone down in the gorge, you've got signal.
lines.es: Repetidor arriba. Los que estén en el cañón, ya tienen señal.

lines.notes: Last wave dead, output above the floor. Relief under the gravel.
lines.en: All contacts down. The dam holds. Good work, both banks. The lights stay on tonight.
lines.es: Todos los contactos abatidos. La represa resiste. Buen trabajo, las dos márgenes. Esta noche no se apaga la luz.

lines.notes: Output fell under the floor. Flat, beaten.
lines.en: We're below the floor. The grid's gone dark... All pilots, pull back.
lines.es: Estamos bajo el mínimo. La red se apagó... Todos los pilotos, repliéguense.

lines.notes: The rack is empty with attackers alive.
lines.en: No birds left. We can't hold it... All pilots, pull back.
lines.es: No quedan aparatos. No podemos sostenerla... Todos los pilotos, repliéguense.
